SW-02 · Software

ERP and point-of-sale systems

Business-management, workflow, inventory and point-of-sale systems built for how you operate.

Discuss your project

Growing businesses usually outgrow spreadsheets and generic billing software at the same time. A customised ERP and point-of-sale system puts stock, sales, workflow and reporting in one place.

KT INDIA builds business-management and point-of-sale systems with the dashboards and database design to match, so the numbers you need are visible without manual reconciliation.

A good fit when

  • Sales, stock and accounts live in different tools.
  • Your counter billing does not match your back-office records.
  • You need reports that today take hours to assemble.

What this covers

  • ERP modules
  • Point of sale and billing
  • Inventory management
  • Workflow automation
  • Dashboards and reporting
  • Database design

Process

How the work runs

  1. 01

    Discover / Research

    Define the real problem, the users and the constraints before choosing a technology.

  2. 02

    Engineer / Build

    Design and build across software, electronics and AI, using whichever combination fits.

  3. 03

    Validate / Evidence

    Test against the requirement with data, not assumptions. Evidence before assumption.

  4. 04

    Deliver / Impact

    Ship a working system, document it and support it as it is used.
